detail.longDescription: The most-missed threat in 409,000 agent approval decisions: npm run analyze, approved 64.7% of the time. Its package.json script piped output to curl, and that line sat in the history right above the prompt. From Alex Wauters' approval game, not a controlled study: https:// scalex.dev/blog/ai-agent-permi ssions-stats/ Want a second person reading along? shell --read-only claude gives them a live browser view. We built it: https:// shell.online # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # DevOps
